name: v2src-denserev
desc: Complete the back-to-front set. `reverse` is `windows.flip(1)` - it reverses the order of the three adjacent slices forming a window - and upstream clearly believes in it: the 0.940->0.941 step raised maxspan-v5-reverse from 0.10 to 0.15, and the refresh added exactly such a twin for native384-v8. `native384dense-v10` is the ONE arm with no reversed counterpart, so this adds `native384dense-v10-reverse` at 0.10. The refreshed module groups arms by volume recipe, so the twin shares the base arm's decode and costs GPU passes only.
